caption: The drawing depicts a full-length, long-sleeved women's dress in dark blue or black with a fitted bodice and a flared skirt. The bodice has buttons down the front, a slight peplum at the waist, and is adorned with white lace trim at the collar and cuffs. The skirt is floor-length with subtle pleating and a row of buttons continuing down the center. To the right of the colored dress, there is a simple line sketch outlining the back view of the same dress, showing the shape and seam lines without any color or detail, on a plain, light background.
title: Dress
